_meta.description: Placement plausibility registry for counterfactual (CF) generation. Externalized from bddl_preprocessor._VISUAL_CATEGORY (physical type) and _INCOMPATIBLE (forbidden category->surface pairs) (WS-4 hardcoding audit). Loaded at runtime; the in-code dicts are byte-identical fallbacks for the historical entries.
_meta.physical_category_semantics: Maps each asset to a coarse PHYSICAL type used to (a) classify a destination object's surface and (b) decide whether a CF object may plausibly be placed on a given surface. Labels: {bowl, cookware, mug, book, bottle, carton, container}.
_meta.incompatible_semantics: Each [category, surface] pair forbids generating a CF that places an object of that physical_category onto that surface. 'surface' is the destination's type: either a physical_category (when the destination is an object) or a fixture keyword {stove, shelf, rack, table} derived from the destination region name.
_meta.axis_note: physical_category (placement) is INTENTIONALLY distinct from cf_category (visual-grounding similarity) in cf_category_groups.json. wine_bottle and ketchup share physical_category=bottle here but differ in cf_category there. Do not merge the two axes.
_meta.coverage: All 34 registry assets have a physical_category, so every asset participates in the compatibility check. Historical _VISUAL_CATEGORY covered 27; the 7 additions are justified below.

physical_category_additions.yellow_book: book: parallels black_book (was already implicitly book-like; explicit now).
physical_category_additions.corn: carton: packaged food good (unloadable asset; best-effort).
physical_category_additions.cherries: carton: packaged food good (unloadable asset; best-effort).
physical_category_additions.bowl_drainer: container: dish rack/drainer that holds items.

incompatible_additions.[bottle, stove]: Fills a coverage gap: bowl/carton/book/mug are already barred from a cooking surface, but bottles were not. A wine_bottle/ketchup/mayo balanced on a stove is as implausible as the others. This newly bars existing bottle CFs onto stoves and covers the new asset mayo. Intentional behavior change (file-present path only), justified by consistency with the existing stove rules.

_meta.curator_process: When a new asset enters asset_variants.json, add a physical_category here (and, if it introduces a genuinely new placement constraint, an incompatible pair). cookware (frypan) is deliberately NOT barred from stove — a pan on a stove is correct.
